description: 🚀 Let's explore the Moon together! We are Team Skyflyers, passionate about space exploration, AI, and innovation. Our project, LUNA-LINK – Intelligent Lunar Landing Site Navigator, aims to identify safe and scientifically valuable lunar landing sites. We welcome enthusiastic members skilled or interested in Python, AI/ML, data science, UI/UX design, research, and space technology. Join us to collaborate, innovate, and make a difference!
